publishing_account_refresh_lease_pair_ch.name: publishing_account_refresh_lease_pair_check
publishing_account_refresh_lease_pair_ch.value: ("publishing_account"."refresh_lease_token" IS NULL AND "publishing_account"."refresh_lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("publishing_account"."refresh_lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "publishing_account"."refresh_lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

publishing_account_active_credentials_ch.name: publishing_account_active_credentials_check
publishing_account_active_credentials_ch.value: "publishing_account"."status" <> 'active' OR ("publishing_account"."provider_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "publishing_account"."access_token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "publishing_account"."credential_format_version" IS NOT NULL AND "publishing_account"."credential_key_id" IS NOT NULL AND "publishing_account"."credential_updated_at" IS NOT NULL)

video_checksum_pair_check.name: video_checksum_pair_check
video_checksum_pair_check.value: ("video"."verified_checksum_algorithm" IS NULL AND "video"."verified_checksum_value" IS NULL) OR ("video"."verified_checksum_algorithm" IS NOT NULL AND "video"."verified_checksum_value" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("video"."verified_checksum_value")) > 0)

video_ready_check.name: video_ready_check
video_ready_check.value: "video"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("video"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "video"."verified_size_bytes" = "video"."expected_size_bytes" AND "video"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "video"."failure_message" IS NULL)

video_invalid_check.name: video_invalid_check
video_invalid_check.value: "video"."state" <> 'invalid' OR ("video"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "video"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)

video_failure_pair_check.name: video_failure_pair_check
video_failure_pair_check.value: "video"."failure_message" IS NULL OR "video"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL

video_deleted_check.name: video_deleted_check
video_deleted_check.value: "video"."state" NOT IN ('deletion_pending', 'deleted') OR "video"."deletion_requested_at" IS NOT NULL

multipart_upload_closed_check.name: multipart_upload_closed_check
multipart_upload_closed_check.value: "multipart_upload"."state" NOT IN ('aborted', 'expired') OR "multipart_upload"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL

multipart_upload_failure_pair_check.name: multipart_upload_failure_pair_check
multipart_upload_failure_pair_check.value: "multipart_upload"."failure_message" IS NULL OR "multipart_upload"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL

upload_part_checksum_pair_check.name: upload_part_checksum_pair_check
upload_part_checksum_pair_check.value: ("upload_part"."provider_checksum_algorithm" IS NULL AND "upload_part"."provider_checksum_value" IS NULL) OR ("upload_part"."provider_checksum_algorithm" IS NOT NULL AND "upload_part"."provider_checksum_value" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("upload_part"."provider_checksum_value")) > 0)

publication_vk_remoteOwnerId_remoteMedia.name: publication_vk_remoteOwnerId_remoteMediaId_uidx
publication_vk_remoteOwnerId_remoteMedia.where: "publication"."platform" = 'vk' AND "publication"."remote_owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "publication"."remote_media_id" IS NOT NULL

publication_lease_pair_check.name: publication_lease_pair_check
publication_lease_pair_check.value: ("publication"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "publication"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("publication"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "publication"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

publication_published_check.name: publication_published_check
publication_published_check.value: "publication"."state" <> 'published' OR ("publication"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "publication"."remote_media_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("publication"."platform" = 'youtube' AND "publication"."remote_owner_id" IS NULL) OR ("publication"."platform" = 'vk' AND "publication"."remote_owner_id" IS NOT NULL)))

publication_remote_identity_pair_check.name: publication_remote_identity_pair_check
publication_remote_identity_pair_check.value: "publication"."remote_owner_id" IS NULL OR "publication"."remote_media_id" IS NOT NULL

publication_failure_pair_check.name: publication_failure_pair_check
publication_failure_pair_check.value: "publication"."failure_message" IS NULL OR "publication"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL

publication_attempt_request_sent_check.name: publication_attempt_request_sent_check
publication_attempt_request_sent_check.value: "publication_attempt"."state" NOT IN ('request_sent', 'succeeded', 'ambiguous', 'reconciled_succeeded', 'reconciled_absent', 'manual_review') OR "publication_attempt"."request_sent_at" IS NOT NULL

publication_attempt_success_check.name: publication_attempt_success_check
publication_attempt_success_check.value: "publication_attempt"."state" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'reconciled_succeeded') OR "publication_attempt"."remote_media_id" IS NOT NULL

publication_attempt_remote_identity_pair.name: publication_attempt_remote_identity_pair_check
publication_attempt_remote_identity_pair.value: "publication_attempt"."remote_owner_id" IS NULL OR "publication_attempt"."remote_media_id" IS NOT NULL

publication_attempt_terminal_time_check.name: publication_attempt_terminal_time_check
publication_attempt_terminal_time_check.value: "publication_attempt"."state" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'definitely_failed', 'reconciled_succeeded', 'reconciled_absent') OR "publication_attempt"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

publication_attempt_failure_pair_check.name: publication_attempt_failure_pair_check
publication_attempt_failure_pair_check.value: "publication_attempt"."failure_message" IS NULL OR "publication_attempt"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL
